pages.title: L_Ender's Cataclysm
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Large, hard bosses guarding their own structures, for well-geared players.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Main bosses have 233 to 420 health (2 health is one heart).
- Ability keys: **Home**, **End**, **Insert**, **Delete**.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Boss gear is made with Create machines here: [#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm x Create](entry://exploration/cataclysm_create)[#]().
**L\_Ender's Cataclysm** adds large, hard bosses guarding their own structures, each with unique weapons, armor and materials. The fights are meant for well-geared players.

Bosses include:

- the Netherite Monstrosity
- Ignis
- the Harbinger
- the Leviathan
- Scylla
- the Ancient Remnant
- Maledictus
- the Ender Guardian
- the Ender Golem

Structures, and where they sit:

- **Sunken City**: deep ocean (a good [#](2E5AAC)[submarine](entry://ocean/submarines)[#]() trip)
- **Burning Arena**: the Nether
- **Ruined Citadel**: the End highlands and midlands
- **Frosted Prison**: snowy plains
- **Cursed Pyramid**: desert
- **Ancient Factory**

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Watch out:** the mod's own message says the Leviathan is invincible outside water, so plan to fight it wet.\
\
For gear crafted in this pack see [#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm x Create](entry://exploration/cataclysm_create)[#](). Other bosses: [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#]().

Ability keys are set in this pack:

- **Home**: general ability
- **End**: boots
- **Insert**: helmet
- **Delete**: chestplate

Change them under Controls, Cataclysm.

pages.title: Ignitium Ingot
pages.text: Boss material. Ignitium, Cursium and Black Steel each make a gear line.

pages.title: The Incinerator
pages.text: Its recipe starts with a Netherite sword. Check [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#]().

pages.title: The Annihilator
pages.text: Its recipe starts with a Netherite pickaxe. Check JEI.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Boss health (2 health is one heart): Netherite Monstrosity **420**, Ignis **315**, Ancient Remnant **315**, Maledictus **294**, Leviathan **280**, Harbinger **273**, Scylla **273**, Ender Guardian **233**.
